sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com): Noelle Silva abilities, Sea Dragon's Roar, Valkyrie Dress. Read through search summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine.
sources.other_en: Secondary English pages found by search (TV Tropes character page, Baidu Baike, Deltia's Gaming): used for spell names the wiki summary did not repeat; they disagree on some names (Nest / Lair).
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells.md.

spells.name: Water Creation Magic: Sea Dragon's Waterball
spells.note: A large swirling sphere of water launched at the target. Mode 0 of the Water book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Water Creation Magic: Sea Dragon's Roar
spells.note: A dragon-shaped water attack of very high destructive power.

spells.name: Water Creation Magic: Sea Dragon's Nest (Lair)
spells.note: A hemispherical water barrier with whirlpools that deflects attacks. Some pages call it Lair.

spells.name: Water Creation Magic: Sea Dragon's Cradle
spells.note: A large sphere of water that carries Noelle and her allies through deep water.

spells.name: Point-Blank Sea Dragon's Roar
spells.note: The Roar from a hand against the target's body. It follows a trained Roar.

spells.name: Valkyrie Armor: Sea Goddess's Dress
spells.note: Awakened in the Elf Reincarnation arc against the reincarnated Letoile: the late page of the book. The existing page keeps its ArmourCast hook.

spells.name: Water Magic: Aqua Javelin
spells.note: 15 spells for every grimoire (pages15, batch 2): a shared Water page that Noelle's sets did not list. A lance of high-pressure water; no source ties it to Noelle by name, so it opens early and stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Sea Dragon God's Vortex
spells.note: NEW shared page (pages15, batch 2). The 'Vortex' of the Sea Dragon God spells that one low-quality source lists for Noelle (unconfirmed); a whirlpool that drags foes in.

spells.name: Sea Dragon's Scale Mail
spells.note: Existing shared page (pages15, batch 2): the water-scale armour of the Water book, listed for Noelle so her grimoire reaches 15 pages.

spells.name: Sea Dragon's Torrent
spells.note: Existing shared page (pages15, batch 2): a wide stream of water, listed for Noelle so her grimoire reaches 15 pages.

spells.name: Mermaid Form
spells.note: Existing shared page (pages15, batch 2): the wiki's Mermaid Form (boosts her power underwater), listed for Noelle; it follows the Nest.

spells.name: Valkyrie Tide Lance
spells.note: Existing shared page (pages15, batch 2): the lance of the Valkyrie armour, so it opens after the Valkyrie Dress page.

spells.name: Sea Dragon's Wrath
spells.note: Existing shared signature page (pages15, batch 2): the strongest Water page, opened by a well-used Roar and high mastery.

planned.name: Saint Valkyrie Dress (Undine)
planned.note: Comes from the water spirit Undine and purifies malice. In this mod it is the Water book's Spirit Dive page (the Valkyrie plates); owned by the Valkyrie lane, nothing to add here.

planned.name: Valkyrie Armor: Dragon Form
planned.note: (Japanese read from the owner's picture of the wiki's variations.) Sea God Leviathan's power. The dragon and mermaid forms are built by the Valkyrie lane; add them as pages after that.

planned.name: Mermaid Form
planned.note: Boosts her power underwater. Same lane as the Dragon Form.

planned.name: Black Dragon Form
planned.note: Named in the owner's reference picture of her variations; no description found.

planned.name: Sea Dragon God's Vortex / Tail
planned.note: Listed by one low-quality source only: unconfirmed, no page.

notes: Not in Noelle's grimoire (kept in the basic Water book): Aqua Javelin, Sea Dragon's Wrath, Valkyrie Tide Lance, Sea Dragon's Scale Mail and Sea Dragon's Torrent were not found in any source for Noelle.
